subtitles.text: Besides... I don't know how to look her in the eye.
She doesn't know the first thing about me...
But she acts like we've been best friends for our whole life.
Trying to cuddle up to me at every opportunity she gets...
I've gotten so used to eating all our meals together.
Always laughing at each other's silly stories...
Enjoying the most delicious of foods...
with anything but a huge beaming smile on her face.
If she finds out I've been trying to kill her all along...
Will she burst into tears? Or get mad at me?
Surely even she couldn't laugh it off.
I don't want to wipe that smile off her face...
She's already had everything taken from her.
But through it all, she's held on to a spark of joy,
and I'm going to take that too?
What kind of monster could go through with that?
